editorial.blurb: Miku Sushi delivers fresh, beautifully presented Japanese fare with standout preparations that keep loyal guests returning, though consistency and service timing can vary.
editorial.insiderTip: Take advantage of the 1/2 off drinks and rolls happy hour before 6pm, and order the bacon-wrapped scallops—reviewers rave about them every visit.
